talk.transcript: Today, we're discussing the concept of biodiversity. Biodiversity refers to the variety of life in the world or in a particular habitat. It includes the diversity of species, genetic variations, and ecosystem diversity. High biodiversity is crucial for ecosystem stability, as it enables ecosystems to function more effectively. For example, diverse ecosystems can better withstand environmental stressors, such as climate change and diseases. Conservation efforts are essential to protect biodiversity, as many species are threatened by habitat loss and pollution. By preserving biodiversity, we also ensure the health of our planet and the resources we rely on.

questions.explain: 生物多樣性是指地球上生命的多樣性。
